prompts.title: Who will be with you
prompts.hint: The people you'd like beside you, and anyone you'd rather wait outside.

prompts.title: What helps you feel calm
prompts.hint: Music, prayer or chanting, soft light, moving around, a hand to hold: whatever settles you.

prompts.title: Pain relief to talk over
prompts.hint: What you'd like to know about the options, and anything you already feel strongly about. Your doctor will go through them with you.

prompts.title: Just after the birth
prompts.hint: Holding your baby close, photos, quiet time together, and when you'd like visitors.

prompts.title: Feeding wishes
prompts.hint: How you hope to feed your baby, and any help you'd like with it.

prompts.title: Anything else
prompts.hint: Customs, prayers, food from home, or anything you'd like your doctor and family to know.
